description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kosgoda, Kuruwita D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620275 (22/695)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels. It contains detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and legal status of properties, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
